label: Act's simple priority over potency: route use, first-being version and a composition route
summary:
Target: STMT-ACT-SIMPLY-PRIOR-TO-POTENCY (a4d3261a) on the critical spine to STMT-GOD-EXISTS. (1) Map: its four verified derivations share no leaf. Under strict expansion (least fixpoint, leaves only underived statements) the minimal cuts of size 3 are the twelve sets {9226c6af} x {6b9fedc2, 6ca87431, 010988b9, excluded middle} x {8a1d7012, bf374f2e, a4606a6b}; no-self-motion (079b53bf) has nine verified derivations and is not a leaf; cutting through it gives at least 120 further minimal cuts of size 4. 3b2d2d46 (IndependentPriority) has the same Lean body over the freely supplied InPotency (POTENCY_2); a4d3261a links adopted POTENCY_1 on a type with the same free parameter, a recorded sense-link defect (not relinked: adopted-potency specializations consume it). Its eight earlier consumers are 6c6549ae, 8f956c81 and six Dei Filius routes. (2) Route use: noComponentFirst, the only derivation of 09c6d5f0, applies act priority only at a supposed first component; at base every root-route loss on removing a4d3261a ran through 09c6d5f0, the classical-root route included; the endpoint loss via 3b2d2d46 appears only when both are removed. firstBeingNoPotency is unbypassable only inside the classical-root Lean proof. (3) Weak version FirstBeingActPriority (61ad11f3): since nothing other than a first being is prior to it, the witness is the first being itself, so it says a first being's potencies are in act in the same respect and carries no priority over other beings. Registered as strictly weaker than 3b2d2d46 (Control.ColdStone); equivalent given non-overlap to STMT-FIRST-BEING-IS-IN-NO-WAY-IN-POTENCY (Control.Facts); noComponentFirstOfWeak rederives 09c6d5f0 from it. (4) Price of the strong reading: with non-overlap and 86efed1a it gives every being in potency in a respect a distinct concrete predecessor, existing at w, in the profile's selected relation, which is in act in that respect (Control.Facts item 4). This is a price, not an established objection: with formal act an actually hot predecessor of a cold stone; with virtual act eminent containment, which the routes already assume in a related form (376d6a5a); no independent case that the commitment is false is recorded. (5) Positive tree: firstBeingNoPotencyOfComposition proves the q.3 a.1 conclusion directly, without act priority or non-overlap, and weakOfComposition the weak version, from: every first being is in act in some respect (8288ff1e); act with potency makes composite (3d99779b, analyst converse of q.3 a.7 co. fourth reason, InPotency the free POTENCY_2 presupposing real passive potency, Composite the inclusive SIMPLE_4 sense, restricted so prime matter does not falsify it); every composite has a distinct cause of its being (ca07cae9); causing another's perfection is efficiently causing it (e0088de9, the bridge from CAUSE to efficient cause, added after review); efficient cause prior (e078f07b). Each needed (Control.CompositionOmissions). The proof applies each premise only at a supposed first being; 3d99779b, ca07cae9 and e078f07b are stated universally, so first-being instances would suffice. No premise says that an idle potency of a being other than a first one has a prior being in act. (6) Graph at STMT-GOD-EXISTS, ten root arguments: removing a4d3261a and 3b2d2d46 left 2/10 before, 9/10 after (92ab7c94 lost: 8f956c81 consumes 3b2d2d46 directly); with both removed, removing any one of 8288ff1e, 3d99779b, ca07cae9 gives 2/10, e0088de9 1/10 (as it already does alone), e078f07b 0/10. Senses: PRIOR_1 throughout; temporal and substance senses only through existing explicit coverage and bridge; no unbridged passage between receptive potency and potency type-checks; on the composition route PRIOR_1 is constrained only by e078f07b and IsFirstBeing; 86f10ec3's potency link corrected to POTENCY_2; c6d6379b's label says POTENCY_1 while it links POTENCY_2 (follow-up). Failed or rejected approaches: (a) deriving the weak version from Aquinas's reduction reason: vacuous at a first being, whose potencies are idle (ActPriorFromMotionFacts item 5); (b) unrestricted 'whatever is in potency is composite': prime matter would falsify it if counted among the beings, so it was restricted to beings in act in some respect, adding premise 8288ff1e; (c) a first spec with the weak version linked to POTENCY_1 and premise a4d3261a: rejected by truth check as unbridged mixing with the POTENCY_2 non-overlap record; (d) STMT-FIRST-BEING-IS-IN-NO-WAY-IN-POTENCY was registered only from act priority (ae14b14d); the composition tree also proves it directly, now registered as firstBeingNoPotencyOfComposition; (e) adding the cause-to-efficient bridge e0088de9 to noComponentFirstOfWeak: rejected by truth check, because 2b25a78c links the external-esse-cause sense of 'causing an effect' while its type uses plain CausesIn; relinking 2b25a78c breaks the existing noComponentFirst argument's links; kept the existing pattern and recorded the defect. Objections (substantive objection standard): strongest standing rival is an existentially first being with actualized accidental states (dipolar theism, a necessary initial cosmic state; unread leads from memory), targeting premise 2 or 3 by the distinction between dependence for being and for an accidental actuality; price: an uncaused composite first being or a simple being in act and potency; not an established counterexample. Quantum indeterminism: targets the reduction reading as universal; its mechanism is interpretation-dependent and the tree does not use reduction. No independent warrant recorded for premises 1 and 2. Provisional judgment: the live question moves to premises 2 and 3 at a first being, with premise 1's warrant also open. Nothing is established; all new premises are open.
